Dihydromyricetin (DHM) is a natural flavonoid extracted from plants like *Hovenia dulcis* (the Japanese raisin tree) that is ` [Highlight start] commonly used as an over-the-counter hangover and liver-support supplement [Highlight end] `.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1_xCaf-an45-BBDmRjffnqRWh1rMLQyp8GEpsrTurE6gHpsHyIQHaKriQPtILNbJ9wudlv3W_4yUTTt5ld2EEku2T4dTKJib8EUJrNiVQ1kCMTsewjaW8rSNwm4fvg3m60-EDwqLzqd2scSaZpnSgtt_F5ZLeRime390hgF5)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF1zE12T_YoFaU3LMQfbLSZj-Q-_AXa5ZWwzj-dDueQOBGjXwxw9lDziAwxtpiAO_jjuK1BU1qhOK_O_eNQuPkAJzDK3YN9jo-akTlvn2H6X1VSte9GkyZhv2gSUg7CxlPMVR7ElH0u-b25yPclj451QmbQn_7vpdXVWqfaDu3wresUud9jC_hZkr1)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXvesy5QskCHroiMI6orbm9beGPiHMFemRMIgC8VB2xnmAJwPz4Y4lPxtsDI7rMwsyR4Sgfokl7FWU79IpUERcftcDvS-5IljEUwPusZrnQtL-Sz1-TcRhIL1SxCGKpAq9YD056afHoXg)

### How DHM is Supposed to Work

- **GABA-A Receptors:** Preclinical research on animals and cells shows that DHM interacts with GABA-A receptors in the brain, which may help counteract alcohol-induced changes and reduce some feelings of intoxication or withdrawal-like grogginess.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXX_fNENzw77UxKeXGCeqswtOGYUbyMIKbtk7CT7R1xOB3F-Hz30xGwYGLowqD-c5HQA-Fq9DLOs7O4jeYhU796-qXFDo3giHNG9LWFosITNXjIZTsSGmOcXxbv-ZrFJF0cwxbnV8ISPebP)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF10njK0GZIA1WmQGIVQ8bp3bSym5AnGc5mBpw3iv3WL-iS7Z_VBNOPJVMxibBfFHs_PODUfnRBubvX9P-eHeelZbf7zqTF4E3T_ltGE42sF1WoEVoG27tfM2epY1KBdyWOGbCn-iHsIWHQDHrTry4eeT7G3YWUJjm92EvAngqpXTqPEc)
- **Oxidative Stress:** DHM has antioxidant properties that may help reduce reactive oxygen species (ROS) and cellular inflammation caused by alcohol processing.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXKR6ex1NwRZQ9S8RhZe_xHqHIVjsxa6ysKg0IKdckyolA11vadyKmc5iSGrrF0QF9XQhP25yhB7EXjOVCG-w98ilghJWngL8Sj2HDqWvZlgZTqKBLeGZ1kUf5bF9ppSZ28_eCuqssUFhv)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXvesy5QskCHroiMI6orbm9beGPiHMFemRMIgC8VB2xnmAJwPz4Y4lPxtsDI7rMwsyR4Sgfokl7FWU79IpUERcftcDvS-5IljEUwPusZrnQtL-Sz1-TcRhIL1SxCGKpAq9YD056afHoXg)

### What the Science Actually Shows

- **Limited Human Evidence:** Most of the data supporting DHM comes from lab or animal (rat/mouse) studies. Controlled, large-scale clinical trials in humans are sparse, and results have been mixed.
- **No Effect on Alcohol Clearance:** Studies suggest DHM does *not* speed up how fast your liver metabolizes alcohol or clears acetaldehyde.
- **Not a Hangover Cure:** No supplement can completely prevent or cure a hangover.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF1zE12T_YoFaU3LMQfbLSZj-Q-_AXa5ZWwzj-dDueQOBGjXwxw9lDziAwxtpiAO_jjuK1BU1qhOK_O_eNQuPkAJzDK3YN9jo-akTlvn2H6X1VSte9GkyZhv2gSUg7CxlPMVR7ElH0u-b25yPclj451QmbQn_7vpdXVWqfaDu3wresUud9jC_hZkr1)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXvesy5QskCHroiMI6orbm9beGPiHMFemRMIgC8VB2xnmAJwPz4Y4lPxtsDI7rMwsyR4Sgfokl7FWU79IpUERcftcDvS-5IljEUwPusZrnQtL-Sz1-TcRhIL1SxCGKpAq9YD056afHoXg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXKR6ex1NwRZQ9S8RhZe_xHqHIVjsxa6ysKg0IKdckyolA11vadyKmc5iSGrrF0QF9XQhP25yhB7EXjOVCG-w98ilghJWngL8Sj2HDqWvZlgZTqKBLeGZ1kUf5bF9ppSZ28_eCuqssUFhv)

### Safety and Considerations

- **Dosage:** There is no universally established clinical or standard human dose for DHM, though commercial products commonly range from a few hundred milligrams per serving.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXVQdI9rI7lNYQgmoPnDUQe3KjgBKoM7YnoDo6v6I21icVDW3Op7Pshja7jB3-YPvAbuEavf1u_9cIBtlxwgF70wy4zBTDJwpQonyf3qGbt3vrzaQFDcESlgi_p4ETKbhKfG-StFIKGR9qI8WNrWTOzAhG2Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF1zE12T_YoFaU3LMQfbLSZj-Q-_AXa5ZWwzj-dDueQOBGjXwxw9lDziAwxtpiAO_jjuK1BU1qhOK_O_eNQuPkAJzDK3YN9jo-akTlvn2H6X1VSte9GkyZhv2gSUg7CxlPMVR7ElH0u-b25yPclj451QmbQn_7vpdXVWqfaDu3wresUud9jC_hZkr1)
- **Side Effects & Interactions:** DHM is generally considered well-tolerated in short-term studies, but long-term human safety data is limited.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF1zE12T_YoFaU3LMQfbLSZj-Q-_AXa5ZWwzj-dDueQOBGjXwxw9lDziAwxtpiAO_jjuK1BU1qhOK_O_eNQuPkAJzDK3YN9jo-akTlvn2H6X1VSte9GkyZhv2gSUg7CxlPMVR7ElH0u-b25yPclj451QmbQn_7vpdXVWqfaDu3wresUud9jC_hZkr1)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXVQdI9rI7lNYQgmoPnDUQe3KjgBKoM7YnoDo6v6I21icVDW3Op7Pshja7jB3-YPvAbuEavf1u_9cIBtlxwgF70wy4zBTDJwpQonyf3qGbt3vrzaQFDcESlgi_p4ETKbhKfG-StFIKGR9qI8WNrWTOzAhG2Q)
- **Real-world User Experiences:** On forums like [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF16eBoPRa-LyKgvp4Qi4dcnSQPNA5zzIh8n2w-IZn0hBvM2kUEYh2d9XIWK9syKSgFbe__CbkixRr6Ok2Z_xP6zwJCd2heDV3Z5Os3hjW1OQJP44KPWikmQSiA2LAhyix31SVFDJTCXCYEcBPDC9enV2AkHkaLA44mL92nneLY60s) , opinions are mixed; some users feel DHM lessens the "buzz" or grogginess, while others notice little to no difference in how they feel the next day.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF16eBoPRa-LyKgvp4Qi4dcnSQPNA5zzIh8n2w-IZn0hBvM2kUEYh2d9XIWK9syKSgFbe__CbkixRr6Ok2Z_xP6zwJCd2heDV3Z5Os3hjW1OQJP44KPWikmQSiA2LAhyix31SVFDJTCXCYEcBPDC9enV2AkHkaLA44mL92nneLY60s)
